stepTitle: The empirical distribution of any statistic we choose will be roughly normal based on the Central Limit Theorem, but it requires our population to have a normal distribution to begin with.
stepBody: Now, you are interested in estimating the average amount of plays their songs have online. You generate a separate 80% confidence interval for this new parameter to be [700000, 1200000] based on a random sample of $$50$$ songs.
